contracts.codable: All original nonblank lines, including CodingKeys, defaults, enum cases, strings, numbers and schema versions, are present with zero missing/extra after only wrapper, qualifier and visibility normalization.

contracts.structured: StrictJSON duplicate/unknown-key checks, duplicate-key lexer, semantic validation and error mapping retain original statements.
contracts.validation: NovelDocumentValidator retains one validate/validateTransition entry, same call order, same issue Set/sort aggregation and validated transition token.
contracts.transaction: Collection and manual edit/sync methods stay on the same NovelFactTransactionReducer type and retain original document/receipt/ledger/revision statements.
contracts.repository: One NovelFileProjectRepository actor, same commitProject and installValidatedCommit bodies, same cache/sidecar/index state owners.
